items.headline_en: Mika Operates Android Apps and Web On-Device
items.summary_en: Mika is an on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to get tasks done. Users can delegate app and web actions to an AI on their device instead of handling every step manually; the project has received 8,798 GitHub stars in 18 days.

items.headline_en: Blender AI MCP Add-on Offers Visual Chat and Scene Tools
items.summary_en: The Blender AI MCP add-on adds an AI assistant and MCP server to the 3D creation app, with visual chat, scene tools, multi-agent workflows, and bpy scripting through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, and OpenCode. Users can handle scene operations through chat rather than performing every task manually; BlenderMCP is a comparable alternative, and the add-on gained 1,903 GitHub stars in four days.

items.headline_en: Yogurt: Private AI Meeting Notes
items.summary_en: Yogurt is a free, open-source AI meeting-notes app for Mac, Windows and Linux that keeps notes on the user’s computer. Users can keep meeting notes locally instead of relying on a cloud notetaker; a comparable option is Granola.

items.headline_en: Capri: Local-First Windows AI Agent
items.summary_en: Capri is a local-first Windows desktop app that acts as an AI agent, comes with a cyberpunk-style HUD, and can control files, apps, the terminal, and the browser through Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, or another backend. Users can handle everyday computer actions through one interface instead of separately opening and managing different tools.
